       s.opendate,

FROM picked p

WITH w AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount)::numeric AS total_wd
  FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  GROUP BY a.district_id

WITH fl AS (
  SELECT l."loan_id", l."amount", l."account_id", l."duration", l."payments", l."status", c."client_id", c."birth_date"
  FROM loan l JOIN disp d ON d."account_id"=l."account_id" AND d."type"='OWNER'
  JOIN client c ON c."client_id"=d."client_id" WHERE c."gender"='F'
), top3 AS (
  SELECT * FROM fl WHERE "amount" >= (SELECT MIN("amount") FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "amount" FROM fl ORDER BY "amount" DESC LIMIT 3) t)
), reg_loans AS (
  SELECT dis."a3" AS region, COUNT(l."loan_id") AS region_loans
  FROM loan l JOIN account a ON a."account_id"=l."account_id"
  JOIN district dis ON dis."district_id"=a."district_id" GROUP BY 1
), dist_avg AS (
  SELECT "district_id", "a3" AS region, AVG("a11") AS dsal FROM district GROUP BY 1,2
), reg_sal AS (
  SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(dsal)::numeric, 2) AS region_avg_salary FROM dist_avg GROUP BY 1
), tx AS (
  SELECT "account_id", COUNT(*) AS tx_count,
         SUM(CASE WHEN "type"='PRIJEM' THEN "amount" ELSE 0 END) AS deposits
  FROM trans GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT t."client_id", t."amount" AS loan_amount, t."duration" AS duration_months,
  ROUND((t."payments"*t."duration")::numeric, 2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND((t."payments"*t."duration" - t."amount")::numeric, 2) AS interest_paid,
  t."status" AS loan_status, dis."district_id", dis."a2" AS district_name, dis."a3" AS region,
  tx.tx_count, ROUND(COALESCE(tx.deposits,0)::numeric,2) AS total_deposits,
  CASE WHEN COALESCE(tx.deposits,0) > 2*t."amount" THEN 'High Income'
       WHEN COALESCE(tx.deposits,0) > t."amount" THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS income_category,
  rl.region_loans, rs.region_avg_salary,
  DATE_PART('year', AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', t."birth_date"))::int AS age_2026_10_09
FROM top3 t
JOIN account a ON a."account_id"=t."account_id"
JOIN district dis ON dis."district_id"=a."district_id"
LEFT JOIN tx ON tx."account_id"=t."account_id"
LEFT JOIN reg_loans rl ON rl.region=dis."a3"
LEFT JOIN reg_sal rs ON rs.region=dis."a3"
ORDER BY t."amount" DESC

WITH gold AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id FROM card c JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  WHERE c.type = 'gold' AND d.account_id IS NOT NULL
),
tot AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ext AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (t.bank, t.account)) AS ext_cnt
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold) AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ln AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_cnt FROM loan l
  WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold) GROUP BY l.account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT g.account_id, di.a2 AS district_name, di.a3 AS region,
    COALESCE(tot.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
    COALESCE(tot.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(ln.loan_cnt, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(ext.ext_cnt, 0) AS external_counterparties
  FROM gold g
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
  JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
  LEFT JOIN tot ON tot.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ext ON ext.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.account_id = g.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_received, total_withdrawn, loan_count, external_counterparties,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS rank
FROM base
ORDER BY rank, account_id

    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn
  FROM trans t WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold)
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ext AS (
  SELECT t.account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (t.bank, t.account)) AS ext_cnt
  FROM trans t
  WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold) AND t.bank IS NOT NULL AND t.account IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.account_id
),
ln AS (
  SELECT l.account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_cnt FROM loan l
  WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM gold) GROUP BY l.account_id
),
base AS (
  SELECT g.account_id, di.a2 AS district_name, di.a3 AS region,
    COALESCE(tot.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
    COALESCE(tot.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
    COALESCE(ln.loan_cnt, 0) AS loan_count,
    COALESCE(ext.ext_cnt, 0) AS external_counterparties
  FROM gold g
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = g.account_id
  JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
  LEFT JOIN tot ON tot.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ext ON ext.account_id = g.account_id
  LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.account_id = g.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_received, total_withdrawn, loan_count, external_counterparties,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS rank
FROM base
ORDER BY rank, account_id

WITH base AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened, a.district_id
  FROM account a
  WHERE a.district_id = 21 AND a.date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
),
owner AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dp.account_id) dp.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
  FROM disp dp JOIN client c ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
  WHERE dp.type = 'OWNER'
  ORDER BY dp.account_id, dp.disp_id
),
cards AS (
  SELECT dp.account_id, count(*) AS n_cards
  FROM card cd JOIN disp dp ON dp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
  WHERE cd.issued <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY dp.account_id
),
loans AS (
  SELECT account_id, count(*) AS n_loans,
    bool_or(status = 'B') AS has_b,
    bool_or(status IN ('C','D')) AS has_cd
  FROM loan
  WHERE date <= DATE '1996-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
tx AS (
  SELECT account_id, count(*) AS n_tx,
    COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount END), 0) AS money_in,
    COALESCE(sum(CASE WHEN type IN ('VYDAJ','VYBER') THEN amount END), 0) AS money_out,
    max(balance) AS peak_bal
  FROM trans
  WHERE date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND date <= DATE '1997-12-31'
  GROUP BY account_id
),
prof AS (
  SELECT b.account_id, b.opened, o.gender,
    date_part('year', age(DATE '1996-12-31', o.birth_date))::int AS age_1996,
    COALESCE(cd.n_cards, 0) AS n_cards,
    COALESCE(l.n_loans, 0) AS n_loans,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(l.n_loans, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
      WHEN l.has_b THEN 'defaulted'
      WHEN l.has_cd THEN 'repaying'
      ELSE 'paid off'
    END AS loan_label,
    COALESCE(t.n_tx, 0) AS n_tx,
    COALESCE(t.money_in, 0) AS money_in,
    COALESCE(t.money_out, 0) AS money_out,
    COALESCE(t.peak_bal, 0) AS peak_bal
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN owner o ON o.account_id = b.account_id
  LEFT JOIN cards cd ON cd.account_id = b.account_id
  LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.account_id = b.account_id
  LEFT JOIN tx t ON t.account_id = b.account_id
)
SELECT account_id, opened, gender, age_1996, n_cards, n_loans, loan_label, n_tx, money_in, money_out, peak_bal,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_bal DESC) AS peak_rank
FROM prof
ORDER BY peak_rank, account_id
final.answer: Built one profile row per Tabor (district 21) account opened on or before 31 Dec 1996, ordered by peak-balance rank (RANK, highest first) then account id. Owner gender and age come from the OWNER disposition; cards and loans are counted only if issued/approved on or before 31 Dec 1996; 1997 transaction count, money in (PRIJEM), money out (VYDAJ + VYBER) and peak balance use 1997 activity, with zeros where there is none. Loan label follows the B > C/D > A hierarchy with 'no loan' when none. The query returns 20 of the qualifying rows in the preview; the full result set is what the submitted SQL produces. Note: I excluded account 12 and similar accounts opened after 1996 since they were not held as of 31 Dec 1996.

bc AS (SELECT molecule_id, count(*) AS n_bonds, count(*) FILTER (WHERE bond_type IN ('=','#')) AS n_mult FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id),
ct AS (SELECT b.molecule_id, count(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS n_ctb FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id=b.bond_id JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id=c.atom_id WHERE a.element='c' GROUP BY b.molecule_id)

final.sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT cdscode, fundingtype FROM schools
  WHERE statustype = 'Active' AND fundingtype IN ('Directly funded','Locally funded')
),
f AS (
  SELECT cdscode, "Enrollment (K-12)" AS enr, "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS pct
  FROM frpm WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
),
sat AS (
  SELECT cds, avgscrread + avgscrmath + avgscrwrite AS total
  FROM satscores
  WHERE avgscrread IS NOT NULL AND avgscrmath IS NOT NULL AND avgscrwrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT s.fundingtype,
  count(*) AS school_count,
  sum(f.enr) AS total_enrollment_2014_2015,
  round((avg(f.pct) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS avg_pct_frpm,
  round(avg(sat.total)::numeric, 2) AS avg_combined_sat,
  count(sat.total) AS schools_with_sat
FROM s
LEFT JOIN f ON f.cdscode = s.cdscode
LEFT JOIN sat ON sat.cds = s.cdscode
GROUP BY s.fundingtype
ORDER BY s.fundingtype
final.answer:
Directly funded: 903 active charter schools, 373,123 total 2014-2015 K-12 enrollment, average FRPM-eligible percentage 63.91%, average combined SAT 1,350.84 (across 165 schools reporting scores).
Locally funded: 370 active charter schools, 161,770 total 2014-2015 K-12 enrollment, average FRPM-eligible percentage 47.20%, average combined SAT 1,475.90 (across 40 schools reporting scores).
Counts are limited to schools with statustype = 'Active' (closed, merged and pending excluded). Meal eligibility uses the K-12 FRPM (free or reduced-price) percentage, converted from the stored 0–1 scale to 0–100. Schools without SAT results are included in the count, enrollment and meal averages. Note: the schools table is row-filtered to charter = 1 in this environment.

SELECT p.title, count(DISTINCT x.other) AS related_cnt
FROM posts p
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT l.relatedpostid AS other FROM postlinks l WHERE l.postid = p.id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT l.postid AS other FROM postlinks l WHERE l.relatedpostid = p.id
) x ON true
WHERE p.title ILIKE '%principal component scores%'
GROUP BY p.id, p.title
HAVING count(DISTINCT x.other) = (
  SELECT max(c) FROM (
    SELECT count(DISTINCT x2.other) AS c
    FROM posts p2
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT l.relatedpostid AS other FROM postlinks l WHERE l.postid = p2.id
      UNION ALL
      SELECT l.postid AS other FROM postlinks l WHERE l.relatedpostid = p2.id
    ) x2 ON true
    WHERE p2.title ILIKE '%principal component scores%'
    GROUP BY p2.id
  ) s
)

WITH wd AS (SELECT a.district_id, SUM(t.amount) AS total_wd FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.district_id),
so AS (SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) AS total_so FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id GROUP BY a.district_id),
ac AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS n_acc FROM account GROUP BY district_id),
base AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.a2 AS district_name, d.a3 AS region, d.a4::bigint AS population, wd.total_wd, ac.n_acc, COALESCE(so.total_so,0) AS total_so
  FROM district d
  JOIN wd ON wd.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN so ON so.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN ac ON ac.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.a4::bigint >= 100000
)
SELECT district_name, region, population, total_wd AS total_withdrawn,
  ROUND(total_wd::numeric / population, 2) AS wd_per_inhabitant,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_wd::numeric / population DESC) AS rnk,
  ROUND(total_so::numeric / n_acc, 2) AS avg_so_debit_per_account
FROM base
ORDER BY rnk, district_name
final.answer: The query returns every district with at least 100,000 inhabitants that has withdrawal (VYDAJ) transactions, ranked by withdrawals per inhabitant with competition ranking (1, 1, 3 style). Columns: district name, region, population, total withdrawn, withdrawals per inhabitant (2 dp), rank, and average standing-order debit per account held in the district (total standing-order amounts in the district divided by all accounts in the district, including accounts with no orders; 2 dp). The top of the ranking is Usti nad Orlici (766.25 per inhabitant, rank 1), followed by Zlin (757.68, rank 2) and Karvina (723.77, rank 3). The query tool displays at most 20 rows, so I only saw the first 20 districts of the ranking; the submitted query returns the full set.

  LEFT JOIN district di ON di.district_id = a.district_id

with acc as (

owner as (
  select d.account_id, c.gender, c.birth_date

),

  from card c join disp d on d.disp_id = c.disp_id
  where c.issued <= date '1996-12-31' and d.account_id in (select account_id from acc)
  group by d.account_id
),
loans as (
  select account_id, count(*) as n,
    case when bool_or(status = 'B') then 'defaulted'
         when bool_or(status in ('C','D')) then 'repaying'
         else 'paid off' end as label
  from loan
  where date <= date '1996-12-31' and account_id in (select account_id from acc)
  group by account_id
),
tx as (
  select account_id, count(*) as n,
    sum(case when type = 'PRIJEM' then amount else 0 end) as money_in,
    sum(case when type in ('VYDAJ','VYBER') then amount else 0 end) as money_out,
    max(balance) as peak
  from trans
  where date between date '1997-01-01' and date '1997-12-31' and account_id in (select account_id from acc)
  group by account_id
),
prof as (
  select a.account_id, a.opened, o.gender,
    extract(year from age(date '1996-12-31', o.birth_date))::int as age,
    coalesce(cd.n, 0) as cards_n,
    coalesce(l.n, 0) as loans_n,
    coalesce(l.label, 'no loan') as loan_label,
    coalesce(t.n, 0) as trans_n,
    coalesce(t.money_in, 0) as money_in,
    coalesce(t.money_out, 0) as money_out,
    coalesce(t.peak, 0) as peak
  from acc a
  left join owner o on o.account_id = a.account_id
  left join cards cd on cd.account_id = a.account_id
  left join loans l on l.account_id = a.account_id
  left join tx t on t.account_id = a.account_id
)
select account_id, opened, gender, age, cards_n, loans_n, loan_label, trans_n, money_in, money_out, peak,
  rank() over (order by peak desc) as peak_rank
from prof
order by account_id
final.answer: Returned one row for each of the 48 accounts at the Tabor branch (district_id 21), ordered by account id, with the requested profile fields. Peak rank uses RANK on 1997 peak balance (highest first, ties share a rank, next rank skipped). Notes: 'Tabor' was resolved via the district table (district_id 21). Owner was filtered explicitly to type OWNER, since the table's row filter did not hide DISPONENT rows. Card counts include cards on all of an account's dispositions, which is the only way to attach cards to accounts.
